2060. Department-wise Salary Report

80

Hard

Write a Java program to simulate generating a department-wise salary report from a database.

Each employee contains:

Employee ID
Employee Name
Department
Salary

Read N employee records.

Then read a department name.

For the given department, calculate:

Number of employees
Total salary
Average salary
Maximum salary

Display the result in the following format:

Department: <department>
Employee Count: <count>
Total Salary: <total>
Average Salary: <average>
Maximum Salary: <maximum>

If no employee belongs to the given department, display:

Department not found
